verdict.reasoning: Garvit's Type C original content drives his highest engagement due to his authentic Hinglish tone and free-resource positioning. However, integrating competitors' structured multi-layer frameworks (e.g., 'Layer 1 to 5' or multi-agent breakdowns) will elevate his content from simple 'hacks' to high-authority developer content.
verdict.recommended_hook_structure: [Negative Command / Pattern Interrupt in English] + [Local / Free Value Proposition in Hinglish] (e.g., 'Stop buying [Paid Tool] subscriptions right now! Ek Indian developer ne isko completely free kar diya hai.')
verdict.recommended_body_structure: 1. Visual Proof/Flex ('Look here...'). 2. Structured Layer Breakdown (Layer 1: Basic, Layer 2: Workflow, Layer 3: Enterprise). 3. Pain-point resolution ('Now this problem is solved').
verdict.recommended_cta_structure: Just comment '[KEYWORD]' and I'll send you the entire workflow guide straight to your DMs.
avoid_these: Generic tech news recaps without an actionable free resource or prompt.
Purely formal English scripts that suppress his natural Hinglish personality.
Vague call-to-actions without comment-automation keyword triggers.
